subsystem: API19 ViewRootImpl first traversal, IWindowSession relayout and root Surface
observed_discontinuity: The closed ViewRoot attach path scheduled a traversal, but had no consumer, measured root, relayout result, window frame, layout, or root Surface.
required_semantics: The scheduled first traversal is consumed before performTraversals executes.
The root hierarchy is attached before measurement and relayout; measured dimensions derive from display constraints and LayoutParams.
WindowSession relayout maintains window identity, visibility, requested size, frame/insets and a persistent Surface result.
A previously invalid Surface becoming valid schedules another traversal before draw.
